subject: Strata Supplies vendor onboarding form failing with 403 CSRF
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma.park@strata-supplies.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Unable to submit vendor onboarding form - CSRF 403 on Coupa

Hi Soojin,

We started the supplier onboarding for Strata Supplies today but are getting a 403 when we try to submit the Coupa onboarding form. Steps we took: logged in via our Okta SSO, filled the required fields, clicked Submit and got a page that says 403 Forbidden - CSRF token missing or invalid. We tried in Chrome and Edge, same result.

I attached a screenshot (screenshot_403.png). Tenant ID shown in the URL is redwood-coupa-prod if that helps. We have a hard deadline to accept a PO from one of your buyers next week; can someone help us either unblock the portal or provide a manual submission option?

Files attached: screenshot_403.png

Thanks,
Emma Park
Vendor Operations
Strata Supplies
onboarding@strata-supplies.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0198

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <emma.park@strata-supplies.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unable to submit vendor onboarding form - CSRF 403 on Coupa

Hi Emma,

Thanks for the report and the screenshot — that helps. Sorry you ran into this. A few quick asks while we triage:

- Can you confirm the browser versions you tried (full version string is ideal)?
- Did you try in an incognito/private window?
- Are you behind a corporate proxy or VPN that might strip cookies?

Workaround: I attached a manual PDF you can fill and return (vendor_onboarding_manual_fill.pdf). If we can get the filled PDF plus your W9, we can create your supplier profile manually and proceed with PO issuance while we fix the portal.

I have looped in Ben and Marissa from Platform/Onboarding to look into the root cause. We will open an internal ticket and update you within one business day.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_manual_fill.pdf

Best,
Soojin Lee
Procurement Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Emma Park <emma.park@strata-supplies.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unable to submit vendor onboarding form - CSRF 403 on Coupa

Hi Soojin,

Thanks, I filled the manual form and attached it here.

Notes: we are definitely using Okta SSO. We did try incognito and it behaved the same. Our IT team thinks the issue is that the Coupa form submission is being treated as a cross-site POST and SameSite cookie rules are blocking the session token, which results in the missing CSRF token on your side. Attached: Strata_onboarding_filled.pdf and our W9 as a separate file (w9_strata.pdf).

Hope that helps. Please let me know if you need anything else so we can get the PO processed.

Best,
Emma
Attachment: Strata_onboarding_filled.pdf, w9_strata.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: platform follow-up - Strata CSRF 403 (SUPP-4127)

Internal only.

Marissa, placing this on your plate to coordinate with Platform Engineering. Summary: external vendor Strata Supplies hitting 403 CSRF on Coupa onboarding form; likely SameSite cookie enforcement for SSO flow. Vendor provided filled PDF and W9.

Action items:
- Opened ticket SUPP-4127: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SUPP-4127
- Platform: check the coupa proxy cookie headers (SameSite and Secure flags) and the CSRF validation middleware logs for redwood-coupa-prod tenant.
- Ops: short-term mitigation is to temporarily relax CSRF strictness for the onboarding endpoint for the tenant and add a narrow rule to allow the Okta-origin POST.
- Marissa please coordinate change window with security and confirm rollback plan. Communicate ETA to Soojin so we can update the vendor.

Ben Carter
Site Reliability Engineer
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <emma.park@strata-supplies.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unable to submit vendor onboarding form - CSRF 403 on Coupa

Hi Emma,

Good news: Platform applied a narrow rule to the onboarding endpoint for redwood-coupa-prod and confirmed the SameSite cookie behavior was the root cause. You should now be able to submit the Coupa form. We verified by completing a test submission with a Strata test account.

Next steps for you: please try the portal submission once more. If anything still fails, reply and we will process the manual PDF you already returned so we can complete your supplier profile and accept the PO.

Also, Marissa will follow up to confirm the ETA for when the portal-wide fix will be deployed so other vendors are not impacted.

Thanks for your patience, and congrats on being nearly onboarded.

Soojin Lee
Procurement Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
